name: learning-space
description: Teach on a shared canvas: Codex sees the learner's handwriting and draws, explains and checks work in Learning Space.

interface.shortDescription: Teach on a shared canvas where the learner writes by hand.
interface.longDescription: Learning Space is a local desktop canvas for learning. The learner writes and draws by hand; with this plugin, Codex sees the board, places explanations and diagrams beside the learner's work, and checks each step. Codex reads what the learner wants: a hint, an explanation, material or a second opinion on their drawing. The app runs on your Mac and keeps your work in a local folder.
defaultPrompt: Look at my board in Learning Space and check my last step
Teach me how derivatives work on the Learning Space board, one small step at a time
Give me a hint for the problem I wrote in Learning Space, but not the answer
